title: Chapter 55 Currency And Merchants
content:
Chapter 55 Currency And Merchants

Wu Qing entered the room customized for him in the One-Star Mother's Nest, and his consciousness returned to the stand-in.

Returning to the Tiger Territory, Wu Qing finally understood how the lords of this world used luck to develop their territories.

The reason is very simple. In this world, luck is currency, money. If you have money, you can buy things.

This money can be used directly when necessary, and its effect is very magical and powerful.

Wu Qing came to Meng's mansion, and Meng took out a handful of beads of different sizes. These beads were round, white, and crystal clear. The small ones were the size of soybeans and the large ones were the size of glass marbles.

He picked out ten beads the size of glass marbles and handed them to Wu Qing, saying: "Take these 1,000 points of luck. This time I took advantage of you."

"I'm not being pretentious. I know you have just established a territory and you definitely don't have many luck beads. Take these luck points and buy some blank luck beads."

Wu Qing took the luck bead and played with it carefully. The system had already given a prompt.

Found 100 [Qi] points, do you want to absorb it?

Wu Qing chose no.

Ten beads are worth 1,000 points of luck, and one bead is worth 100 points. A little bit of luck in this world is exactly a bit of the system's qi resource.

"It seems that this is all calculated by the system."

Wu Qing didn't say anything. He picked up a soybean-sized bead that was placed on the table. As expected, the system prompted that 1 point of Qi had been found.

This makes it very clear. The smallest luck bead is 1 point of the system's qi resource. The medium size should be 10 points, and the large size should be 100 points. Is there any other types of luck beads? Wu Qing can't. And know it.

He suddenly mentioned the blank Qi Luck Bead, indicating that after the Qi in the Qi Luck Bead is used up, the bead can still be used.

"I really don't have this luck bead here, Meng, can you tell me about this luck bead?"

When Wu Qing came into contact with the Qi Luck Pearl for the first time, he thought a lot, but he didn't show it and asked Meng naturally.

Meng looked at Wu Qing curiously, but he didn't ask any more questions.

"Okay, let me tell you about this luck bead."

Meng was a little surprised that Wu Qing didn't understand the Qi Luck Pearl, so he chose to ignore the problem and patiently explained it to Wu Qing.

"Ever since someone became a lord, people have had an intuitive understanding of luck, but people have discovered that the amount of luck cannot be quantified."

"People have conducted a lot of research on the use of Qi. During the research process, people found that some substances can store the invisible and qualityless Qi."

"Many people have continued research and experiments in this direction, and finally discovered a substance that is most suitable for storing luck. It is a kind of shell bead bred in the body of a magical shellfish organism."

"As soon as this research result was announced, it attracted great attention from the major lords. After joint research and decision by the major lords, the minimum volume of shell beads that can carry Qi luck and the amount of Qi luck stored is defined as 1 point of Qi. transport."

"On this basis, many lords have invested a lot of resources to cultivate and improve this mysterious shellfish creature. After many years of research and accumulation, we have finally achieved the mass production of shell beads of various specifications."

"After countless years of development and standardization, everyone formulated unified standards based on the energy storage capacity of shell beads, and the current currency system was formed."

"This kind of shell bead is a luck bead, and the shell creature that can give birth to shell beads is called a luck shell."

He will tell you the origin and development history of this luck bead.

Wu Qing played with the luck beads and had to marvel at the magic of nature. Even luck can be stored and manifested.

"Wu Qing, you haven't used luck beads yet, right?"

It is strongly guessed that this mysterious human lord does not even know the luck beads, so he must have never used the luck beads.

"It's true that I haven't used it before. I've only been a lord for a few days, and it's my first time to come into contact with many things."

Wu Qing replied calmly that he did have a lot of common sense about lords that he didn't know. He was not sure which type of people in this world should know this common sense.

Meng probably thought that he was a talent cultivated by a hidden family, and he should know many things.

But the fact is that Wu Qing doesn't know a lot of basic common sense.

This made Meng have more guesses about Wu Qing's identity.

"The simplest way to use this luck bead is to use it directly. You know that the lord can use the territory's luck through the lord's scepter. When there is excess luck, he can replenish the luck with the blank luck bead, so that Store and carry luck.”

"When necessary, these luck beads can be taken out and used."

"Conversely, the lord's scepter can also reversely absorb the luck in the luck beads to increase the luck of the territory."

"Ordinary people who get Qi Luck Beads can also absorb Qi Luck to improve their own strength, or perform Qi Luck secrets, or bless items, cure diseases and save people, etc."

"The most important thing is that they have luck beads with them, which can prevent strange injuries to a certain extent."

"It can be said that luck beads are a supreme treasure for ordinary people."

Wu Qing listened attentively.

"Of course, since luck beads are called currency, their main function is still trading."

"There is a kind of lord. Their lord's scepter is not bound to the territory, but to a caravan formed so that they can become merchants."

"Merchants can protect caravans and travel around, sell and trade goods, accumulate luck, and develop caravans into more powerful chambers of commerce."

"The chambers of commerce of powerful merchants even exist in the entire local ethnic camp, and their strength is stronger than the top clans."

"These chambers of commerce have their own operating system, and almost everything can be bought from them with luck beads."

"Using luck beads to buy things is the fastest way for us to develop our territory with luck!"

"It just so happens that a caravan will come to this area in the next few days, and we will go shopping together then."

"..."

Meng's explanation is very detailed.

A mighty tiger-headed man nearly three meters tall is explaining in detail to a handsome young human man over one meter eighty. This picture is very abrupt, and there is an indescribable sense of harmony.

After Meng's introduction, Wu Qing finally had a comprehensive understanding of the common sense that the lord of this world should know.

The Lord's Staff can not only bind the territory, but also bind the caravan. If we think about it further, it should also be able to bind other organizations. Meng did not say this, but there should be such a Lord.

The Lord who binds the caravan will become a businessman, and the Lord who binds other organizations may become other special professions.

This world has a strange influence, and everything seems to be inseparable from the Lord.

The Lord's Staff bound to the entity can gather basic luck, which can provide shelter for the bound entity organization to avoid being affected by the weirdness.

The protected territory and organizational entity in turn gather luck for the Lord. This is a mutually beneficial development process.

"Even merchants are Lords. This world is really wonderful!"

Wu Qing still knows too little about this world.
